recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric composition featuring a colossal, weathered stone face emerging from shadows above a balustrade, rendered in a grainy sepia-toned lithographic style with a prominent vertical text block on the left margin.
coreVisualRelationships: The large-scale face acts as a spectral presence looming over the architectural foreground.
The vertical text block creates a rigid structural anchor against the soft, smoky textures of the image.
High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting defines the facial features while obscuring the surrounding environment.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or lithographic texture
Vertical text orientation along the left edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, centered face occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, appearing massive in scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical text column on the far left provides a stable vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the sharp vertical text on the left, across the central face, and down to the balustrade in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and smoky textures fill the corners, creating a claustrophobic, ethereal mood.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and charcoal shadows provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm sepia and pale ochre highlights define the forms.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-yellow hues in the lower text section provide a subtle color shift.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the highlights of the stone and the deep black background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated vertical stems to accommodate the stacked layout

composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by a dark border or integrated into the left edge

treatment.fill: Solid pale ochre to gold gradient

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying color/value for emphasis.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a grainy, sepia-toned lithograph of a giant stone face emerging from dark smoke above a classical balustrade. Use high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical column of uppercase text on the left side using a high-contrast condensed serif font. The top half of the text should be off-white, and the bottom half should be a muted gold.

verificationChecks: Is the text oriented vertically on the left?
Is the color palette strictly sepia and dark brown?
Does the face have a weathered, stone-like texture?
Is the grain visible and consistent across the image?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left text margin
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the main facial features.
Check that the balustrade is grounded in the lower third.
Verify the lithographic texture is not too blurry.
Confirm the vertical text is legible despite the rotation.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Classical Sculpture] with [Lithographic Texture] + [Vertical Modern Serif Typography] + [Sepia Chiaroscuro Palette].
